topic: Data storage optimization and sampling strategy
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on optimizing data storage, specifically addressing the rapid growth of `device_number_uniq` fields and overall data volume in the sandbox environment. It was noted that removing full unique identifiers (`full uniques`) and other specified fields will significantly reduce storage load.

Regarding sampling, it was confirmed that random data samples are currently applied across all areas except for aggregates. While using sample-based aggregates is possible, it would only be necessary if real-time recalculation becomes unmanageable.

The conversation also touched upon the use of `owner_type_upper` in primary keys and general query design, noting that while the field exists in key structures, its practical usage in standard queries was questioned.
decisions: Full unique identifiers will be removed from storage soon.
Compression improvements are planned using a new Primary Key (PK).
action_items: Implement the removal of full uniques and other specified fields.
Address Brazil's unique identifier issue with an alternative vendor sample.
